Support for the M5Stack Core S3 is still experimental. By the way, the M5Stack Core S3 only supports Bluetooth 5.0 (BLE - Bluetooth Low Energy), but not anymore Bluetooth 4.2 (Classic). Therefore, classical Bluetooth serial connexion won't work on the M5Stack Core S3. So, you will need to use ICUSBProxy(https://github.com/armel/ICUSBProxy). So, if you plan to use the Bluetooth connection, get an M5Stack Core or Core2 instead !

entry.name: Atom Plane Tracker
entry.description:
Atom Plane Tracker turns your M5Stack Atom S3R into a live aircraft radar. It queries a free public ADS-B API — no account or API key required — and displays real-time flight information for any aircraft passing within a configurable radius of your location.

What it shows

When an aircraft enters your radius, the screen lights up with the callsign, aircraft type, altitude, and a live ETA countdown until it exits. The screen color changes by aircraft class — red for military, blue for medevac, green for commercial, yellow for private. Up to 5 recent flights are stored in history for the current session.

Push notifications

Optional push alerts via https://ntfy.sh (free tier, no credit card). Choose which aircraft classes trigger alerts — military, medevac, commercial, private, or all of them. Firmware update notifications are also supported.

Easy setup — no coding required

Flash the firmware once using a browser-based tool, then configure everything over WiFi through the built-in web UI. No software installation needed after the initial flash. Future firmware updates are delivered wirelessly with one click from the web UI.

Key features

- Live aircraft display with class-based color coding
- Real-time ETA countdown between API polls
- Configurable scan radius, coordinates, and poll interval
- Up to 5 aircraft in history per session
- Built-in web UI with live screen preview
- Optional ntfy push notifications by aircraft class and emergency codes
- Automatic daily firmware update checks with OTA install

Requires: WiFi connection

repo_meta.description: ESP32-S3 firmware for the M5Stack Atom S3R — tracks live aircraft overhead via ADS-B, with color-coded alerts, emergency squawk detection, push notifications, and a built-in config web UI. No API key required.
